packageRules.description: ignoreTests: this repo has no CI, so a PR would otherwise never be green. A base digest bump is only built when the owner runs images/build.sh, and that build is its test.
No automerge: a new Superpowers release changes how implementers and reviewers work. After merging, re-run the agent setup (it rewrites the plugin entry) and restart the OpenCode server.

customManagers.description: The Superpowers plugin the agents' OpenCode loads (scripts/lib/render.sh, SUPERPOWERS_VERSION).
